Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the Irish reply! The New Zealand players are out there in the middle. Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie are the openers for Ireland. Lockie Ferguson to start with the ball for New Zealand. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, the target is quite a daunting one for the Irish and New Zealand will fancy defending this total down. However, as we know this is cricket and anything can happen here. Ireland do have some quality batters and a lot will depend on how Paul Stirling goes about his business today. He needs to fire, if Ireland want to chase this total down. We shall be back for the second essay in a while. Stay tuned.

Martin Guptill is down for a quick chat. He says that they wanted to get off to a strong start and him and Finn Allen were able to do just that. Adds that the picth was flatter than the last two games and looks good for batting. Reckons that the total they have on board should be enough but anything can happen in cricket.

Irish bowlers had a tough time in the middle. They gave away way too many loose deliveries with the new ball and they just couldn’t stop the run flow after the Kiwis got off to a good start. Graham Hume on debut could not impress and other bowlers too leaked quite a few runs. Josh Little was the one bowler who bowled some good overs along the way and got two wickets but overall it has been a disappointing performance by the Irish bowlers.

New Zealand were not at their best with the bat in the first two games and it was a perfect setting today with the strip being the best we have seen so far in the series. Martin Guptill and Finn Allen gave the Kiwis a flying start and by the time Allen departed, the score was already 78 in just 10th over. Will Young did not last long but skipper, Tom Latham gave Guptill good company during his brisk knock of 30 runs. However, it was the 96-run stand between Henry Nicholls and Guptill that put New Zealand in an authoritative position. Guptill went onto score his 18th ODI century and Nicholls too was quite fluent scoring 79 off just 54 balls. Glenn Phillips also played a handy cameo in the end and that has ensured that New Zealand get to a huge total here.

New Zealand have posted a mammoth total on the board on a very good batting deck. The Irish bowlers were a bit below-par and now have a humongous task in front of them. New Zealand look favourites to win this one and it will be a record run-chase if the Irish manage to chase this down.

Excellent running! Short again and over middle, Mitchell Santner pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket and races back for the second. The throw from the deep is a bit too wide and Santner is able to get the dive in and slide his bat inside the crease in time. New Zealand finish on 360/6!

Good fielding! Banged in short and over middle, Santner pulls it hard and in front of deep mid-wicket. Gareth Delany runs around to his right from the mid-wicket fence and saves a couple of runs for his team.
FOUR! Length this time, on off stump. Mitchell Santner stands tall and muscles it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
And again! Bowled into the deck and around off, Mitchell Santner is just a bit too eager to get bat on ball and is once again early in his swing.
Nicely bowled! Pace off from Little, bowled into the pitch and around off. Mitchell Santner looks too pull it away but is way too early in his shot.

FOUR! Poor delivery from Little and with that 350 comes up for New Zealand! Full and drifting down leg, Mitchell Santner just about gets a fine tickle on it. The ball runs away into the fine leg fence.

Brilliant penultimate over from the debutant, just 5 runs come off it. Full and wide again, Michael Bracewell creams it through the cover region but Curtis Campher shows excellent agility in the deep to keep it down to a couple.
A low full toss of off, this is heaved away well in front of square on the leg side for just a single.
Good stop! Full and wide again, this time Bracewell hits it firmly and to the left of the man at extra cover but Andy Balbirnie over there makes an excellent stop to keep it down to a single.
Another golden dot ball! Full again and outside off, Bracewell can't get it through the extra cover region.
Full and wide, this is thrashed away to the man at deep cover for just a single.
Perfect length, around the top of middle, Santner blocks it out.
Leg bye! Length this time and sliding down leg, Santner looks to flick it away but misses. The ball goes off the pads and towards short fine leg, they get a leg bye.
Back of a length, around leg stump. Bracewell works it off his hips down to fine leg for a single.
Mitchell Santner is the next man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Really well held by Curtis Campher and Glenn Phillips departs just shy of his fifty! Josh Little deliver it on a length and wide outside off, inside the tramline. Phillips reaches out and tries to slash it over the point fence. Campher charges in from the backward point fence and holds onto it. Phillips departs after a fiery knock and Little does get a wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Curtis Campher b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Josh Little is proving to be really expensive! Length ball on middle, Glenn Phillips thumps it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
WIDE! Full and wide, spilled beyond the tramline outside off, wide signaled.
Banged in short and over middle, Bracewell takes it on and pulls it one bounce to the fielder at deep mid-wicket for just a single.
WIDE! Attempted slower yorker at the toes but it is spilled way down leg, wide called.
FOUR! Back of a length and on middle, Michael Bracewell hangs back and muscles it off the splice of the bat, back past the bowler and into the fence.
Another bowling change as Josh Little comes back on.
Full and wide, this is nicely driven but straight to the man at sweeper cover. Phillips looks to come back for the second but is sent back and rightly so.
Nails the yorker on middle and leg but Glenn Phillips manages to dig it out towards long on for a single.
Very full and very wide, this is driven to sweeper cover for just a single.
SIX! Easy power from Michael Bracewell! Overpitched on off stump and it is the slower delivery, Bracewell stands tall and powers it over the long on fence for a maximum.
Hume gets it into the blockhole this time, outside off. Bracewell fails to dig it out.
WIDE! Full and way down the leg side from Hume this time.
Easy two there! Full and wide, Bracewell steps down the track and sashes it away towards deep cover for a couple of runs.
Graham Hume comes back into the attack.
Goes short again, over leg stump, Phillips pulls it very fine but the fielder at fine leg does cut it off. The batters get a couple of runs.
SIX! BANG! Pitched up this time, on middle and leg, Glenn Phillips just holds his shape and extends his arms to lift it well over the long on fence for a huge hit.
Short again, over middle and leg, this is swatted away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pace on this time, on a hard length and over off. Bracewell charges down the track and looks to go downtown but misses.
Nicely bowled! Young goes for the slower ball bouncer, on off and angling away. Michael Bracewell looks to take it on but is well beaten by the lack of pace.
Very full and straight, Phillips digs it out towards long on and rotates the strike.
Slower delivery, on a length and angling into off. Phillips waits for it and punches it down to long on for one more.
Banged in short and over middle, Michael Bracewell pulls it down to long on for a single.
Good running! Full and wide, squeezed towards point for a quick single.
Slower delivery, on a good length and on midddle, Phillips defends it out.
FOUR! Just a fraction short and angling into middle, Glenn Phillips hangs back and muscles it away into the square leg fence for back-to-back boundaries.

FOUR! Yet another poor piece of fielding and this time it's the skipper who is found guilty. Full and wide, Glenn Phillips thrashes it straight towards extra cover where Andy Balbirnie lets it through his hands and the ball goes away into the fence.
WIDE! Starts the new spell from 'round the wicket and serves a slower bumper going down leg. Wide called.
Josh Little is back on.
Bowled into the pitch and over middle, Michael Bracewell hops back to defend.
Michael Bracewell walks out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Craig Young does the trick on his return and gets the big fish! Yet another slower delivery, this time on a length and on off stump. Henry Nicholls gets low and looks to slog it away but completely misses the ball and the death rattle is heard as the ball crashes into off stump. Nicholls will be a bit disappointed to have missed out on a ton but Young has the breakthrough the Irish so desperately needed.
This is banged halfway down the track and it is the slower bumper. Henry Nicholls reaches out and plays it over the extra cover region for a couple of runs.
Back of a length and close to the off pole, Glenn Phillips punches it out through extra cover and turns the strike over.
Thinking about the second but have to settle for the single. Good length, around off, this is chopped through cover-point for a run.
Nicely bowled! Young charges in and serves a slower delivery, full and outside off. Nicholls looks for the booming cover drive but gets undone by the lack of pace.
Craig Young is back into the attack.
Length this time, around off, Nicholls pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
SIX! Picks the slower ball and hammers it away! This is full and around off, Henry Nicholls moves past the off stump and slogs it away, hard and flat over the square leg fence for a biggie.
WIDE! A bit of a harsh call it seems. Goes for the slower yorker on leg stump, Nicholls moves a bit past the off stump and misses the sweep. A wide is called.

FOUR! Craig Young is having a nightmare of a time in the deep. This is on the pads, Henry Nicholls flicks it towards fine leg where Young fumbles and the ball goes into the fence. The bowler won't be pleased with that one.
Back of a length, around off, this is played off the back foot towards cover for one.
Hume pulls back the length and bowls the off-cutter on middle, the ball comes in off the surface and Phillips gets hit on the body.
Starts off with a fullish delivery, angling into middle and off, Phillips looks to drive it straight but gets no timing whatsoever.
Graham Hume is back on. Six overs for 32 runs on his debut so far.
On a length and on the pads, tucked away 'round the corner for just a single.
Flatter delivery, around middle, Phillips eases it back towards the bowler.
Drops it a bit short this time, around off, Phillips can't get it through covers.
SIX! A gift really from Gareth Delany and it has been punished! Juicy full toss on leg stump, Glenn Phillips muscles it over the square leg fence for a huge hit.
FOUR! Quicker and flatter,, outside off. Glenn Phillips is quick to get on the back foot and punches it past Andy Balbirnie at cover for a boundary.
Tossed up on leg stump, Henry Nicholls looks to use his feet but doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball. Nicholls works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, this time around off, Nicholls drives it towards mid off and picks up yet another single.
Around the top of off, this is punched off the back foot towards mid on for a quick single by Phillips.
Very full and at the toes, this is clipped to deep square leg for just a single.
Two more! On the pads, Nicholls just works it through mid-wicket and races back for the second.
Full and straight, this is driven straight back past the bowler for a couple of runs.

SIX! A bit of misjudgment from Craig Young in the deep and it's gone over his head. This is short and over middle, Henry Nicholls pulls it hard and flat towards fine leg where Young charges in and the ball flies over his head for a maximum.
Powerplay 3! The fielding side can have up to 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle for the final ten overs.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over! Gareth Delany continues to bowl short. It is on middle and Glenn Phillips pulls it wide of long on for a boundary.
Bowls it short again, on off. Henry Nicholls rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter and flatter, outside off. Glenn Phillips looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge to short third man. A quick single taken.
Goes a tad short on middle. Henry Nicholls punches it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off. Henry Nicholls skips down the track and plays it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side, on off. Glenn Phillips punches it to long off for a single.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Glenn Phillips pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.

FIFTY for Henry Nicholls! He has not been at his best in this series before this game but has been at his fluent best today. A short delivery on middle. Henry Nicholls pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on off. Henry Nicholls drives it off the inside half of his blade back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Curtis Campher bowls it a tad short on middle and leg. Henry Nicholls looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads and there is an appeal. The umpire though is not interested. Andy Balbirnie takes the review. The Ball Tracking rolls and it shows that the ball is pitching outside leg. So the original decision stays.
On the shorter side again, outside off. Glenn Phillips punches it to deep extra-cover for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Glenn Phillips looks to punch it away but gets the inside half of his blade to mid-wicket.
Curtis Campher (5-0-30-1) is back on.
Tad shorter on middle. Glenn Phillips works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Glenn Phillips pushes it back to the bowler.
A flatter delivery, around off. Glenn Phillips defends it towards the off side.
Glenn Phillips walks in at number 6.

OUT! LBW! Gareth Delany strikes and that will bring an end to a fantastic knock by Martin Guptill! A big breakthrough for Ireland the one they badly needed. This is a googly that pitches on middle and turns back on. Martin Guptill goes for a big slg-sweep across the line. He misses and gets hit on his back leg. There is a huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger much to the delight of the Irish fans.
Tossed up, on off. Martin Guptill blocks it out.
A fuller delivery on off. Henry Nicholls skips down the track and yorks himself. However, he still manages to dig it out to mid off for a single.
On the shorter side on middle. Henry Nicholls punches it to point for a single. 15 runs from the over!

FOUR! Ohh...this time Henry Nicholls gets a bit lucky! Tossed up delivery, around off. Henry Nicholls skips down the track and looks to defend it. However, he gets a thick outside edge and the ball goes through the vacant slip region for a boundary.
Pushed quicker on middle. Guptill takes a single as he clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Darted on middle. Henry Nicholls works it towards backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! This time a more authorative sweep shot! Fuller on off. Henry Nicholls sweeps it in front of square for a boundary.
FOUR! Another over that starts with a boundary! This is fuller on leg. Henry Nicholls sweeps and gets a bit of top edge. The ball goes over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Delany fires it on leg. Martin Guptill looks to flick it away but misses. The ball hits his pads. 10 runs from the over but good comeback by Delany after the first two deliveries.
Bowls it a tad short on middle. Henry Nicholls works it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg. Martin Guptill sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
Drifted on leg. Martin Guptill looks to sweep it but misses. He gets hit on the pad but it is going down leg.
FOUR! Another boundary! This is full on middle. Martin Guptill drills it past mid on for a boundary.
FOUR! Ohh...that's a full toss and it has been pumped down the ground for a boundary! A low full toss on middle. Martin Guptill hits it over mid on for a boundary.

Drinks break! The Kiwis just keep marching on and have given themselves a great platform to go big in the final 15 overs. With 7 wickets in hand and two well-set batters at the crease, they will be eyeing a score of around 350. The only way Ireland can slow the opposition down is by picking up wickets and that too in heaps. The surface is good for batting but the hosts wouldn't want to chase a score in excess of 300-310. A fascinating phase of play awaits. With that being said, Gareth Delany comes back in for his second spell.
Andy McBrine goes a tad shorter on off. Henry Nicholls goes deep in his crease and cuts it to point.
Darted on middle and leg. Henry Nicholls clips it to mid-wicket.
On the shorter side, around off. Martin Guptill waits for it and then late-cuts it to short third man for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Henry Nicholls clips it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Shorter and outside off. Henry Nicholls rocks back and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle. Henry Nicholls clips it to mid-wicket.
Serves a length delivery, outside off. Martin Guptill looks to drive it away from his body but misses.

SIX! Martin Guptill takes full advantage of the Free Hit and gets to his century in style! He has been one of the pillars of New Zealand batting line-up in white-ball cricket for quite a long time now and he continues to excel here. 18th ODI hundred for him. This is a fullish delivery on middle. Martin Guptill heaves it and gets enough bat on it to send it sailing over the long on fence.
NO BALL! Back of a length, on middle. Henry Nicholls guides it to third man for a single. Josh Little has overstepped and it will be Free Hit coming up now with Martin Guptill on 98!

Ohh...had Tector picked that ball quickly, it would have been trouble for the Kiwis! On the shorter side, around off. Martin Guptill pushes it to point and looks for a single. Tector fails to collect it cleanly and a single is completed.
Back of a length, on off. Martin Guptill dabs it towards point.

Beautifully bowled by Little again! He serves a good-length delivery, outside off. Maybe it is a tad short of good length. Martin Guptill looks to drive it on up but gets beaten as the ball bounces and goes away with angle.
On the shorter side, around off. Henry Nicholls gets on the top of the bounce and guides it towards third man for a single.
Goes fuller again on middle. Martin Guptill drives it back to the bowler. Andy McBrine stops it but seems to have hurt himself in the process.
Straighter line, on middle. Martin Guptill blocks it out.
Slower through the air on off. Henry Nicholls sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Drifting into the pads. Martin Guptill clips it to fine leg for a single. Moves onto 97 now!
Goes fuller on middle. Martin Guptill drives it back to the bowler.
On the shorter side, around off. Henry Nicholls punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Martin Guptill punches it to cover-point.
Lovely delivery! Lands on a good length and it goes with the angle across the batter. Guptill looks to defend but gets beaten off the outside edge of his blade.
Back of a length, angling into leg. Henry Nicholls looks to clip it but misses. The ball deflects off his pads towards backward square leg. A leg bye taken.
Goes a tad fuller on off. Angling across the batter. Guptill looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes past point for a single. 50 partnership also comes up.
Lands on a length, outside off. Martin Guptill square drives it to point.
That's well bowled and equally well played! Back of a length, around off. It cramps Henry Nicholls for room but he still manages to guide it away towards third man for a single.
Josh Little (5-0-36-1) is back on.
So two dots to the over! Turning into middle and leg. Martin Guptill clips it wide of the short fine leg fielder.
Andy McBrine with a flatter delivery on middle. Martin Guptill pushes it right of the bowler.
Another easy single! Flatter on middle. Henry Nicholls punches it to long on for a single.
Pushed quicker on middle. Martin Guptill drives it to long on for a single.
On the shorter side on off. Henry Nicholls stays back and punches it to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Henry Nicholls clips it to mid-wicket.
On a fuller length and around off, Guptill pushes it out on the off side.
FOUR! The Irish pacers just haven't found any consistency with their lengths so far. This is full and wide, driven firmly through the point region for a boundary.
Length again, around off, this time the ball bounces a bit of extra and hits the splice of Guptill's willow.
Length ball, driven on the up well in front of covers and it will be an easy two for Martin Guptill. He moves into the 90s now.
Short again and over middle, this is pulled away from deep inside the crease towards deep backward square leg for a run.

Half an appeal but there's no bat involved. This is on a shorter length, around the hips. Henry Nicholls looks to pull biut misses. The ball clips the thigh pads and the keeper Lorcan Tucker dives down to his right to pouch it.
Goes full and on middle, Guptill presses forward and pushes it towards mid on.
Flatter delivery and pushed through on middle, this is worked away leg side.
FOUR! Drops it a fraction short and around off, Martin Guptill backs away and cuts it late past the man at backward point for a boundary.
A hint of flight and bowled around off, Guptill blocks it off the front foot.
Pulls back the length and bowls it slower, around off. Guptill pushes it back to the bowler.
Starts the new spell from around the wicket and fires it in at the toes. Nicholls just pushes it through mid on for a single.
Andy McBrine (4-0-21-0) is back into the attack.
On the pads, this is flicked away towards fine leg for a single by Henry Nicholls.
Back of a length, outside off, this is just caressed off the back foot towards deep cover for one more. Just milking the runs at the moment these two while still putting away the bad balls.
Length, on off stump, this is turned through mid-wicket for a run.
A bit shorter in length and outside off, this is sweetly punched off the back foot to deep point for just a single.
Back of a length, outside off, Guptill looks to thrash it through covers but gets a bottom edge towards cover-point.
Starts off the new spell with a gentle-paced delivery on off, Guptill stands tall and pushes it out towards covers.
Craig Young is back on.

FOUR! Smart shot from Nicholls! Quicker delivery, pushed through around off, Nicholls just uses the pace of the ball and plays it late past the man at first slip and collects a boundary down to third man.
Pulls back the length and bowls it on middle and leg, Guptill hangs back and works it well in front of mid-wicket for one more.
Floated up around off, Henry Nicholls uses his feet and wrists it through wide long on for a single.
Fuller and on off, this is just pushed towards the man at mid off.
On off and skidding through, Guptill is drawn forward and gets a thick inside edge past square leg. Guptill picks up a single.
Excellent running! On middle and sliding off the surface, Guptill plays it with soft hands and through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Poor delivery from Campher and Nicholls picks up yet another boundary. Short and on off stump, this time Nicholls pulls it a bit in front of square on the leg side and the ball races away into the fence.
SIX! This is banged in short and around off, Henry Nicholls goes forward and across the off stump as he pulls it a long way over the backward square leg fence for a biggie.
Angles in a good-length ball from around the wicket and into middle stump. Nicholls hops and keeps it out.
A touch fuller and around off, this is driven through covers for a single.
Beaten! Good length, outside off, just not full enough to drive but Guptill looks to do so regardless of that, gets beaten past the outside edge.
Back of a length, around off, Guptill chops it back onto the deck off the back foot.
Well fielded! Tossed up on off stump, Martin Guptill drives it firmly to the right of the bowler who gets a hand on it. The ball goes towards mid on as a single is taken.
Good mix-up of pace and length from Delany here. This is quicker and on a length, around off. Guptill watches it all the way through and plays it late towards short third man.
Nice bit of loop, bowled on middle stump, Guptill keeps it out.
Around middle and leg, this is turned through the mid-wicket region for an easy single.
Full and on middle, Nicholls pushes it back towards the bowler.
Floats it up very full, ends up being a low full toss on middle. Guptill pushes it to the left of mid off for a quick single.
Leg bye! This is drifted onto the pads, Guptill looks to flick it away but gets it off the pads down to fine leg. The batters get a leg bye.
On a nagging length, angling in from outside off, Guptill looks to drive on the up but checks his shot in the end and just taps it towards cover.
Back of a length and around off, Guptill hangs back and dabs it down towards point.
FOUR! Dispatched! A half-volley, around off, Martin Guptill leans in and drives it powerfully through wide mid off for a boundary.
Good length again, over middle and leg, Henry Nicholls eases it away towards mid-wicket and sets off for a quick single.
Henry Nicholls walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Curtis Campher, the man with the golden arm has done it again! Campher delivers this one on a good length and angles it into the off pole. The ball just shoots iup off the length and Tom Latham is completely taken by surprise. Latham tries to fend it off the back foot but the ball pops up off the shouler of the bat towards backward point. Harry Tector takes a simple catch and Ireland have a much-needed breakthrough. The skipper departs after a positive start.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Curtis Campher

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A poor delivery to end a decent over by Gareth Delany. Short and wide, cut away past the man at backward point for a boundary by Martin Guptill.
Good piece of bowling by Delany! Tossed up, on middle, drawing the batter forward and Guptill just drives it firmly towards mid on.
Tosses it up now, on off, Guptill defends it off the front foot.
Just a bit too short and on off, Tom Latham pulls it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Nicely flighted, full and on middle. Latham tries to turn it leg side but gets a leading edge towards extra cover.
Starts off with a quicker and shorter one, close to the off pole. Guptill rocks back and slashes it away to sweeper cover for one.
Gareth Delany is into the attack now.
Full and straight driven down to long on for a single. Oh, no! The throw from the deep is a poor one and the batters get a couple of extra runs as well.
And again! Length, on off and this is nudged away towards mid-wicket.
Right around the top of off, Guptill just blocks it out from inside his crease.
Comes from around the wicket to the left-hander and angles it in from around off. Latham hangs back and guides it late down to third man for a run.
Good length, angling into the body, this is worked 'round the corner for a run. With that single, the 50 partnership also comes up between these two.
Campher charges in and serves a length ball around the top of off. Guptill solidly keeps it out off the front foot.
Shorter in length and on off, Guptill gets low and pulls it down to deep square leg for just one more.
Flatter delivery, around off, this is punched away towards cover-point.
Quicker delivery, around middle, Guptill defends it out.
On middle, this is pushed through wide mid on for a single.
Quicker this time and shorter too, turning into off. Guptill plays it late and just nudges it down towards short third man for one.
Floats it up full and around off, Guptill presses forward to defend.
On a length and outside off. Tom Latham drives it and opens the face of his blade a bit. It goes between the backward point fielder and short third man. Two runs taken.
Back of a length, on middle. Martin Guptill clips it towards backward square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Tom Latham drives it to mid off and another quick single is taken.
Back of a length, on middle. Martin Guptill defends it onto the pitch and the batters steal a quick run here.
On a length, on off. It keeps a bit low and Martin Guptill does well to block it out.
On a length, on middle. Tom Latham clips it past square leg for a single.
Shorter delivery again on middle. Martin Guptill pulls it to deep square leg for a couple.

FOUR LEG BYES! Runs continue to flow here! Shorter in length on leg. Martin Guptill gets low and looks to pull it. He misses and the ball goes off his thigh pad towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
On the shorter side on off. Martin Guptill pushes it towards the off side.
Pushed quicker on middle. Martin Guptill blocks it out.
Tossed up on middle. Tom Latham knocks it down to long on for a single.
SIX! Nice use of the feet by the Kiwi skipper! This is fuller on middle. Tom Latham skips down the track, reaches the pitch of the ball and powers it over long on for a maximum.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Martin Guptill drives it firmly towards covers.
Very full, on off. Tom Latham digs it out towards the mid off region and takes a quick single.
Back of a length, around off. Tom Latham get right behind it and defends it towards the off side.
Bowls a short ball on off. Martin Guptill pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Lands on a length, around off. It nips back in with good bounce. Martin Guptill defends it towards the off side.
Back of a length, around off. Tom Latham steers it towards third man for a single.

Drinks break! It was all New Zealand in the first 10 overs with Finn Allen and Martin Guptill both punishing the Irish pacers but since the departure of Allen, the run rate has dropped down a little. Guptill is still out there and is going great guns and the Black Caps will be hoping that he plays a big innings. Ireland have managed to pull back things a bit but will have to pick up wickets in the middle phase in order to not let the Kiwis put on a mammoth total. Curtis Campher now comes into the attack.
Fraction short, around off. Tom Latham guides it through point off the back foot for a single.
On the shorter side on middle. Martin Guptill pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Keeps it a tad short on middle. Martin Guptill punches it back to the bowler.
This time it is fuller on middle. Martin Guptill clips it to mid-wicket again.
On the shorter side on middle. Martin Guptill works it to mid-wicket.
A flatter delivery on middle. Martin Guptill blocks it out.
On a length, on off. Tom Latham blocks it out.
FOUR! Little errs in line and Tom Latham puts it away! This is full drifting on the pads. Tom Latham just tucks it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
A fullish delivery on middle. Tom Latham shuffles across and defends it towards mid on.
Back of a length, around off. It nips back in sharply. Tom Latham is cramped for room and gets hit high on his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side.

An appeal for an LBW, not given! Ireland review! However, the Ball Tracking shows that the ball is missing the stumps and the original decision stays. A length delivery that comes back in with the angle. Tom Latham looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads and it ends up being a dot ball in the end.
On the shorter side, around off. Martin Guptill dabs it towards backward point for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Martin Guptill defends it towards the off side and takes a single.
FOUR! Fifty for Martin Guptill! A fluent knock from the opening batter! On the shorter side on middle. Martin Guptill pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
On the shorter side on middle. Tom Latham works it to backward square leg for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Martin Guptill pushes it to mid on for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Martin Guptill clips it to the leg side.
A flatter one on middle. Martin Guptill defends it towards the leg side.
Andy McBrine to roll his arm now.

FOUR! Another edge and it runs away for a boundary again! A fullish delivery, around off. Tom Latham looks to drive it away. However, he gets an outisde edge and the ball goes through the first slip region for a boundary. Paul Stirling is at widish first slip and has no chance there.
Back of a length, around off. Tom Latham dabs it towards covers.
A fullish delivery, around off. Tom Latham pushes it to covers.
A length delivery, outside off. Tom Latham cuts it to covers.
A fuller delivery on middle and leg. Tom Latham looks to clip it but does not time it well.

FOUR! A thick edge provides a boundary this time! Back of a length, outside off. Tom Latham looks to punch it away. However, he gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies wide of second slip for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Martin Guptill dabs it towards point.
On the pads and fuller. Martin Guptill clips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Back of a length, on middle. Martin Guptill blocks it out.
Lands on a length, on off. Martin Guptill pushes it to covers.

OUT! RUN OUT! Will Young has thrown away his wicket here, brilliant fielding from Curtis Campher though and New Zealand lose their second. This is fuller on off. Young drives it to mid off and sets off for a single. However, it was always going to be a tough run, Curtis Campher at mid off runs to the ball, collects it with right hand and fires a direct hit. The leg umpire takes it upstairs and Young is short of his crease. Big breakthrough for Ireland! Tom Latham is the next man in.
Back of a length, on off. Young blocks it off the back foot.
Back of a length and around off, this is tapped away towards backward point.
WIDE! Back of a length and down the leg side, Guptill looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
Goes full and wide, Guptill leaves it alone.
A bit too straight from Little and on a shorter length as well, Young neatly tucks it through square leg for a single.
A touch fuller this time and around off, Young chops it towards point.
Length again, around off, this is dabbed down towards third man for one.
Back of a length, around off at 137.7 kph. Martin Guptill guides it towards third man for a couple.
Dot to end the over, just 2 from it! Serves a length delivery on middle again. Young only manages to nudge it towards the leg side.
Keeps it on a length, angling into middle. Young works it to short mid-wicket.
Goes a bit fuller on off. Young with a solid block off the front foot.
Drifting on the pads, on a length. Young clips it past square leg and comes back for the second run.
Lands on a length and outside off. Young decides to let it go this time.
A fullish delivery, outside off. Young drives it but straight to the cover fielder in the ring.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
A dot to end a successful over by Josh Little! Around the top of off, Guptill defends this one from inside the crease. At the end of the first Powerplay, New Zealand are absolutely flying at 79/1!
On a good length again and over off stump, Guptill gets right behind the line of the ball to make the block.
Leg bye! Good length and on leg stump, Young looks to flick it away but the ball goes off the thigh pad and towards fine leg. They pick up a single.
Much better line! Length, close to the off stump and just angling across. Will Young makes a watchful leave.
Will Young walks out at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, a bit of reprieve for Ireland! This is short again and on off stump, there to be hit. Finn Allen swivel-pulls it in the air but doesn't quite get the timing right. The ball flies down to the man at the backward square leg fence and George Dockrell takes a good catch. Allen punches his bat in disappointment but Josh Little has done the trick for his side.
Commentary.Howout: c George Dockrell b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! It is raining boundaries for the Kiwis! Just a fraction short and outside off, Finn Allen gets across the off stump again and still manages to time it off the back foot through extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! This has gone to the fence like a tracer bullet! Full and wide, Guptill shimmies down the wicket and he just slaps it away behind point for a boundary.
This is delivered on a length, around off and the ball jags back in a long way this time. Guptill presses forward to defend but gets hit high on the pads.
Back of a length and around off, Guptill punches it out towards cover.
On off stump, this is worked away through the square leg region for a single.
Good-length delivery, around off. Allen taps it towards the cover region.
Short of a length and on leg stump, Guptill hops and looks to tuck it away but the ball goes off the inside edge and towards short fine leg. They get a single.
Change of ends for Graham Hume. He has been expensive from the other end, let's see how he goes about his business now.
FOUR! End of an expensive first over by Josh Little, 15 off it! Around the top of off, Finn Allen just gets across off stump and works it through square leg for a boundary.
Pitched up on off stump, Allen blocks it out.
Leg bye! Length again, around leg stump, Guptill looks to tickle it fine but misses. The ball goes off the pads and towards short fine leg as the batters sneak in a leg bye.

FOUR! Even the good deliveries are traveling to the fence. Around the top of off, just slanting across the right-hander. Guptill gets an outside edge past the man at first slip and the ball runs away into the third man fence.
On a hard length, angling well across the batter. Allen chops it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Just too short again but it's around the midriff region, Finn Allen swivel-pulls it up and over backward square leg for yet another boundary.
WIDE! Starts off with a full and wide one, just a little too wide though.
Josh Little is brought into the attack now.
FOUR! Really poor this from Craig Young and the 50 is up for New Zealand in no time. Full and on the pads, Guptill clips it away into the vacant square leg fence. 16 runs came off that over!
FOUR! A third boundary of the over and all of them have just been timed to perfection. On middle, this is stroked away in front of mid-wicket and the ball just speeds into the fence.
A touch fuller and around off, this is firmly pushed towards the man at mid off.
Perfect length and on a tighter line around off, Guptill leaves it alone.
FOUR! Overpitched and punished! A half-volley on middle stump, Guptill with a lovely straight drive back past the bowler to make it two boundaries in a row.
FOUR! Sweetly timed! The new piece of willow seems to be working fine for Guptill. Good length, around off, this is just caressed off the back foot through cover-point for a boundary.
Length and on middle, kept out by Allen.

In the air, lands safely! Full and straight, Martin Guptill gives the charge and looks to smash it across the line but gets it off the toe end of the bat. The ball lobs over mid-wicket and falls safely as the batters get a single. Guptill has also broken his bat.
Good length, over middle, Guptill nudges it onto the leg side.
A bit of aggression from Guptill but he can't get it away. A little bit short again and around off, Guptill goes a bit too hard at it and ends up mistiming it towards covers.
Keeps it on a fullish length and angles it into middle, Guptill pushes it back towards the bowler.
Much better length this time. Around the top of off and just holding its line. Guptill plays inside the line of the ball.
FOUR! Quick hands from Finn Allen and at the moment the Irish bowlers are just a bit too short. Short and outside off, Allen gets it up and over point for yet another boundary.
Good length, on the pads, Allen fails to get it away.
FOUR! Pre-meditated and nicely maneuvered by Finn Allen! Gets well outside the line of off stump and clips the fullish delivery in front of mid-wicket for a boundary.
No harm done! Length ball, on off but Young takes pace off it. Finn Allen has a big heave across the line but mistimes it badly towards mid on.
NO BALL! Back of a length, around off. Allen goes on the back foot to defend it out on the off side. Craig Young has overstepped and a no ball is called. Free Hit coming up.
This is angled in from outside off, Allen pushes it towards mid off.
Young gets lucky this time around. This is short and wide, Finn Allen fails to get any sort of timing on the cut shot.
A dot to end an expensive over, 15 coming from it. On a fuller length and around off, Guptill leaves it alone.

SIX! Easy as! New Zealand are ripping apart the debutant! Fuller in length and angling into middle, Martin Guptill just nonchalantly lifts it right back over the bowler's head and clears the fence with ease.
Excellent fielding from Harry Tector! Short and wide again, Allen throws his hands at it but can't get it past the Tector at point who gets a good hand on it to his left. Single taken.
Length, around the top of off, Allen watchfully keeps it out on the off side.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Graham Hume and he is punished! Short of a good length but wide of the off stump, Allen rocks back and gets on top of the bounce to thump it past point for another boundary.
FOUR! Up and away! A little too short and wide, Finn Allen slaps it over the man at point and the ball reaches the fence in a hurry.
And again! On a shorter length and close to the off pole, Guptill just lets it through to the keeper.
Shorter this time, around off. Guptill leaves it alone.

FOUR! Was that a chance? Yes, it was! Fuller in length and angling into middle and leg, Martin Guptill flicks it to the left of the man at mid-wicket who can get a hand on it and the ball runs away into the fence.
Nice carry this time around. On a nagging length and outside off, Guptill looks to punch off the back foot but gets undone by the extra bounce.
Back of a length, over middle and just nipping in a touch. Guptill hops back to defend.
Length, around off, this is steered down to third man for a single.
FOUR! Sloppy piece of fielding by Gareth Delany! Pitched up around off, Guptill lifts it over the cover region and the ball trickles down to the fence as Delany fumbles while pulling it back in.

Risky single! Around off, on a shorter length, Allen just drops it towards point and Guptill calls him for the single. Harry Tector picks up the ball and has a shy at the batter's end but misses. Would have been touch and go had that hit.
Pulls back the length a touch and bowls it outside off, Finn Allen has nothing to do with it.
Nicely fielded! A bit too full this time, around off. Guptill strokes it away towards extra cover where the fielder makes a good half stop, allowing just a single to the batter.
Pitches it up on off stump, Guptill solidly keeps it out off the front foot.
Really good delivery to start off your ODI career! Graham Hume goes full and in that channel around off, Martin Guptill looks to drive at it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Graham Hume, the debutant to share the new ball with Craig Young.
Five dots in a row to end the first over, just a single off it! On a good length and angled into the pads. Allen looks to work it leg side but misses and gets hit high on the pads.
Good stop! Length again, drifting onto the pads, Allen looks to work it in front of square but Andy McBrine makes a good stop down to his left at mid-wicket.
Keeps it on a shortish length and on the fifth stump line, Allen defends it out on the off side off the back foot.
Back of a length and around off, Allen punches it off the back foot but straight to the man at extra cover.
A bit of movement on offer now! Good length, outside off and this one shapes away quite a fair bit. Finn Allen lets it through to the keeper.
Starts off with a shortish ball on the body. Martin Guptill stays back and just tucks it away past square leg for a single. New Zealand are underway!
We are ready for play! The Irish players are out there in the middle. Martin Guptill and Finn Allen are the openers for New Zealand. Craig Young to start with the ball for Ireland. Here we go...

Andy Balbrine, the skipper of Ireland says that in the Super League there is always something to play and they have been hot and cold in the league and they need to be better today. Tells that the middle order has done well and they need to bat well at the top. Mentions that they need to do the same thing and just need to be a a bit better in execution. He informs that they have two changes with Graham Hume making his debut.

Tom Latham, the Kiwi skipper says that they will bat first and the surface looks really good. Mentions that it is about improving with every match for them. Adds that in ODI cricket it is really important to keep picking wickets and hopefully the spinners can do what they did in the last match. About Finn Allen, he says that Allen showed fantastic ability last time around and hopes that he can carry on the momentum. Informs that Lockie Ferguson comes back in for Jacob Duffy.

PITCH REPORT - Kyle McCallan is down for the pitch report. He says that it is a fresh day and there's some breeze as well, with a fresh pitch too. Adds that the pitch is the best for batting so far, it is hard and there's fresh grass on it too. Mentions that the captains will be looking to still bowl first and reckons the par score will be around 300.

Ireland (Playing XI) - Andy Balbirnie (C), Paul Stirling, Andy McBrine, Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Gareth Delany (In place of Simi Singh), Graham Hume (On debut) (In place of Mark Adair), Craig Young, Josh Little.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Finn Allen, Will Young, Tom Latham (C) (WK), Henry Nicholls, Glenn Phillips, Michael Bracewell, Mitchell Santner, Matt Henry, Lockie Ferguson (In place of Jacob Duffy), Blair Tickner.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Tom Latham. New Zealand have elected to BAT first.

New Zealand, on the other hand, have won both games but they have been far from clinical. Michael Bracewell has been the stand-out performer for the Blackcaps and he has really been the difference between the two sides. However, the top-order has not lived up to its billing so far and the skipper Tom Latham would hope for a more dominant performance from his boys. Can New Zealand whitewash Ireland here? Or will Ireland boys cross the line this time around? Let’s find out. Toss and team news in a bit.
